messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for The Hop Tap?
messages.body:
Hi Tracey,

Thanks for coming back — and for being upfront on budget.

For The Hop Tap, an 8pm–11pm show (3 x 1 hour) is £400 cash. Own PA, no deposit.

If you book four dates and lock them in, we can do £300 cash for that 3 hour show on each of those nights. If a shorter night suits the budget better, Jake is £300 cash for 2 x 1 hour, or £250 cash each night when you lock four dates.

Those four-date deals tend to fill quickly as Jake is one of a kind, so if you want them locked in it is worth grabbing them soon — 2027 is already filling.
